title: Kirk Cousins: "If I'm not the best option, I don't want to be out there"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kirk Cousins: "If I'm not the best option, I don't want to be out there"
sources.description: As the Raiders were rattling off three straight wins to start the season, the decision to ride with veteran quarterback Kirk Cousins was looking like the right way to go.
